name_prefix.ui:description: 3-20 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens. A random suffix is added to keep names unique.

vm_size.ui:description: Azure VM size. All three are burstable B-series sizes.

public_ip_enabled.ui:description: Give the VM a Standard SKU static public IP.

allowed_ssh_cidrs.ui:description: CIDR ranges allowed to reach the VM on port 22. Leave empty for no inbound traffic at all.
